schema.task_id: Stable id for the task: 'mm-' + the first 12 hex of sha.
schema.sha: The commit that fixed the defect. Ground truth; never shown to the agent.
schema.parent_sha: The pre-task state. The agent starts from a tree extracted at this commit.
schema.committed_at: UTC ISO-8601 commit time of sha.
schema.parent_committed_at: UTC ISO-8601 commit time of parent_sha.
schema.memory_cutoff: Equals parent_committed_at. The memory arm may be seeded ONLY with material authored strictly before this instant. Seeding at or after it leaks the answer and the resulting delta measures the leak, not the memory.
schema.scoring_instant: Date (YYYY-MM-DD) of parent_committed_at, to be passed to recall(scoring_instant=...) so recency scoring is a pure function of the corpus instead of the wall clock.
schema.subject: The commit's single-line subject. The body is never read (it leaks the fix).
schema.task_statement: The prompt an agent is given. Derived from subject only; identical in both arms.
schema.tests_to_run: Test files executed to grade the attempt (the commit's newly added test files).
schema.test_patch_paths: Test-side files laid onto the parent tree before grading, so imports resolve.
schema.fail_to_pass: Node ids that do NOT pass at parent_sha and DO pass at sha. Non-empty by construction.
schema.tier: 'behavioral' = module imported at parent and behaved differently. 'api_construction' = module did not import at parent.
schema.parent_mode: Raw pytest outcome class at the parent: test_failure | collection_error | timeout.
schema.parent_returncode: pytest exit code at parent_sha with the test patch applied (must be non-zero).
schema.task_returncode: pytest exit code at sha (must be 0).
schema.n_src_files: How many files under src/ the reference fix touched.
schema.n_tests_to_run: How many test files are executed to grade the attempt.
schema.src_added_lines: Lines added under src/ by the reference fix.
schema.src_deleted_lines: Lines deleted under src/ by the reference fix.
schema.size_bucket: Mechanical size class from n_src_files alone: 1='single_file', 2-3='small', 4-8='medium', >8='large'. Recorded so a harness can stratify against a threshold it states up front. It is NOT used to select tasks -- dropping the large ones during generation would be curating the set for outcome.
schema.src_changed: Files under src/ the reference fix touched. Metadata only; not in the prompt.
schema.files_changed: Every path the commit touched. Metadata only; not in the prompt.

generator.selection_rule: Non-merge commits on first-parent history from HEAD that BOTH add at least one new tests/test_*.py file AND add or modify at least one src/**/*.py file; ordered newest first by (committer_date, sha); the most recent --limit are validated. No commit is selected, reordered or dropped on the basis of its text, its author, or any expectation about whether memory would help.
generator.pre_exclusion: A candidate whose added test source names a shared production service (psycopg|postgres|postgresql|redis|ollama) is excluded before execution, because this host runs a production Postgres and a GPU-pinned model. Every other exclusion is decided by executing the candidate.
generator.validation_rule: Extract parent_sha and sha with git archive; lay the commit's test-side files onto the parent tree; run the added test files in both. Well-formed iff pytest exits non-zero at the parent, exits 0 at the commit, and at least one node id flips to passing. Each arm runs 2 times in independent trees; a candidate whose own grading disagrees with itself between runs is dropped as nondeterministic_grading.
generator.test_delivery: provided_before_run: the commit's test-side files are laid onto the parent tree BEFORE the agent runs, in both arms. Withholding them is not a viable alternative here -- a task whose tier is api_construction requires names that exist nowhere in the parent tree, so a withheld-test run would fail in both arms for a reason unrelated to memory and would report a null result caused by the harness. Delivery is identical in both arms, so it cannot bias the delta.
generator.determinism: Child environment is constructed, not inherited (TZ=UTC, PYTHONHASHSEED=0, LC_ALL=C.UTF-8, no MIND_MEM_* DSN reaches a run). No wall-clock value is written to this file; the same HEAD reproduces it byte for byte.
